notes.title: Full Version Released – 1.0!
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Players, 
Our game is finally leaving Early Access!
Thank you so much for your support during our Early Access version!
In addition to the features we had planned, we have added many new features and fixed numerous bugs based on your feedback.


Releasing the full version does NOT mean we’re done developing the game!
Below is a list of features and improvements we plan to add. Of course, this list will grow with your continued suggestions.


Upcoming Features:
New Economy Design: A more balanced system that enhances the sense of progression 

Inverse Mouse Controls 

4-Chamber Tanker System: Allows transporting multiple fuel types at once 

Our Own Gas Station: A player-owned and managed station 

Casino: A place to spend or multiply the money you earn from trade 

Optimization: Performance improvements to keep the game smooth even with many products and machines 


Features Added During Early Access:
Cashier: Automatically checks out customer items in the store 

Wholesale System: Accept large orders through a global trade system 

Underground Tanks: Store all types of oil in underground tanks in front of the factory 

Tanker Upgrades: Increase the capacity of your tankers 

First-Person Vehicle Camera 

Auto Transfer Line: Automatically transfers crude oil from excavation sites to underground tanks 


Features Added For Full Version - 1.0:
Auto Production System: Hire a worker and use the tablet app to start automated production 

Warehouse Stocking: Organize and store produced items with new shelving 

Stocking Workers: Automatically place produced items on shelves (shelves must be placed) 

Store Workers: Refill store shelves with items from warehouse stock when empty

notes.title: First-Person Driving Camera + Balance Update v0.6.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 👋❤️

With today’s update, we’re excited to bring you the long-awaited first-person driving camera, along with major changes in production and economy balancing.

🎥 First-Person Driving Camera is Here!
It’s time to really take the wheel!
You can now switch to first-person view inside vehicles and experience a fully immersive driving perspective:


 Authentic cockpit view
 Interactive driving with left-right look support
 Instantly switch back to external view with a single key


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/5d27c0ec0b40e391ab427f812c5e6bbecdb148b4.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/cafcfbe1600dff3cfcab87cb58ecd77efaf9bb55.gif

⚙️ Advanced Pumpjack Updates

 Increased extraction speed: The advanced pump now operates significantly faster. You’ll be able to extract more oil in less time.
 Increased storage capacity: The advanced pumpjack now has higher capacity, allowing it to store more oil while you’re away.


🌍 Zone Yield & Economy Balancing
Zone 5 and Zone 6 now offer increased yield: You’ll now have a much higher chance of finding more oil from a single source in these regions.


 Rental prices updated: Alongside the increased value, the rental cost for Zones 5 and 6 has been raised.
 Economy overhaul in progress: We’ve begun a full rework of the game’s economy to make trading, inventory management, and contracts more meaningful and strategic.


🧭 What’s Coming in the Next Update?

 New truck and tanker purchasing system
 Vehicle save system (Now that major issues are resolved, we’ve begun active work on this feature)
 Improved warehouse wall visuals. Each wall will be customizable with graffiti for a more stylish and personal look


💬 Developer Note
We’ve received a lot of feedback lately about workers in single player mode.
We’re actively developing a system that will work in both single player and co-op modes, but it’s not ready for release just yet.
We want to avoid introducing any unstable or unbalanced features, so we’re testing thoroughly.
While this feature won’t be part of the next update, it won’t be too long before it makes its way into the game.
Thank you for your patience and support. ❤️

🙏 Thanks to your interest, feedback, and continued support, we’re steadily building a truly enjoyable experience together.
With your help, we’re getting closer to a better game step by step. Thank you all! ❤️

notes.title: Storage and Trailer Upgrade Update – v0.5.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋❤️

We’ve been listening to your feedback and today, we’re introducing two major features that expand your production and logistics capabilities:

Underground storage tanks and a trailer upgrade system!

With this update, you’ll be able to store more, deliver more, and operate more efficiently than ever.

🛢️ Underground Fuel Storage is Here!

One of the most requested features, fuel storage, is finally in the game!
Now, a dedicated underground tank is placed in front of the Warehouse for each fuel type.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/7ee4b3c5bad827bbf77c65a2fc7125b81a745c87.jpg

With this system:


 You can safely store excess fuel instead of wasting it,
 Better manage the gap between production and delivery,
 Expand your storage capacity over time for more strategic gameplay.


📱 You can purchase and upgrade these tanks through the brand-new "Underground Tank" app on your tablet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/20c1e3389a1cf0525a0c5d9ab3a2e353ac26f9a8.jpg

🚚 Trailer Upgrade System Added!
Another frequent request: trailer capacity upgrades.
Now, each trailer can be individually upgraded to carry more fuel!

With the new "Trailer Upgrade" app, you can:


 Increase each trailer’s fuel capacity,
 Deliver larger wholesale orders in a single trip,
 Boost your entire logistics flow with smarter trailer usage.
 No more limitations. Your fleet just got a serious upgrade!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/c5c39fd528fbcbc1d2b8805b4a74eaadcc7ad131.jpg

🛠️ Bug Fixes & Performance Improvements

 ✅ Fixed a bug where two different fuel types could appear from the same oil source.
This fix also resolves several related issues caused by that behavior.

 ✅ Fixed an issue where Zone 6 would sometimes only spawn 5 oil sources.
Now Zone 6 will always generate the correct 6 oil sources as intended.

 ✅ Optimized performance issues caused by having too many hoses active at once.
The game now runs smoother and more stable during high-traffic operations.


 We’re incredibly excited to keep growing this game together with you.
Your feedback continues to shape development, and we’re always working to deliver better systems, deeper mechanics, and smoother experiences.

Thanks for your amazing support and happy fuel harvesting! 🚀❤️

notes.title: WHOLESALE UPDATE v0.4.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 👋❤️‍🔥

Today, we’re thrilled to introduce a brand new feature we’ve been working on for a while:

The Wholesale System is now live!

From now on, you won’t just be selling fuel to local stations, you’ll also be exporting it to major fuel corporations across the globe!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/78a985895a0e5d89d9ee66803094277d0413b2d9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/3ba108691af0c486525f7f3004da1b7d5c45bd1b.png

🌐 What Are Wholesale Orders?

With the new system:


 You can now receive large-scale fuel orders from different countries

 Each order varies in fuel type, quantity, and reward value

 Delivering quickly earns you an extra bonus (up to 60%)!]

 You can choose between multiple contract offers to make strategic decisions

 All operations are managed through the specially designed Global Trade Depot

 📱 You can select wholesale orders from the Tablet

 🗺️ You can also see the Global Trade Depot’s location directly on the map


🛠️ Global Trade Depot
A brand-new logistics facility has been added to the map for wholesale trading:


 A high-capacity distribution center


(📝 Note: This is not a regular storage depot  it acts only as a transfer facility.)

⏳ Early Delivery = Big Profit
Every wholesale order comes with an early delivery time limit. If you're quick:


 Deliver fast → Earn up to 60% extra bonus!

 Take too long → You'll still get the base reward, but no bonus


💡TIP
"If you secure enough crude oil before accepting a wholesale order, it will be much easier to deliver within the bonus time!"


✅ Additional Improvements

 Tablet screen now zooms in based on your camera’s FOV
 Minor bug fixes


Thank you so much for your continued support.❤️‍🔥

Let’s keep building this game together! ❤️‍🔥

notes.title: Update Notes Version 0.3.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! ❤️

With this update, we've improved many visual, feel, and smoothness issues that directly affect the gameplay experience. 🙏

We’re truly grateful for all the small but important details you've shared with us while playing! 💬

Every day, together with you, we’re making the game more enjoyable and smoother. 🌾🎮

Here’s what’s new and improved with version 0.3.0:


 🛠️ The placement system has been almost completely rebuilt! Those annoying placement issues that disrupted the experience have been largely eliminated.
 🚛 Passenger seat functionality has been added to trucks! You can now ride together with your friend in Co-op mode. 🤝
 🛬 Fixed an issue where a friend would float in the air after getting into a vehicle in Co-op mode!
 🔄 Pickup trucks, trailers, and big trucks now automatically recover when flipped over no more getting stuck on the road! 🚗✨
 🔄 Palletjacks now also auto-recover when flipped upside down, saving you from frustrating resets! 🛒
 🔤 Fixed the square font issue that appeared in some languages. You'll now see clean and correct text across all supported languages! 🌍
 ⚙️ General improvements have been made to the physics system for smoother driving, more natural movements, and better responsiveness! 🌟
 🛢️ Fixed rare issues when connecting hoses to the Pumpjack, making connections safer and more stable. 🛠️
 ⛽ Selling fuel with tankers now grants you level (XP) progression! 📈
 🛠️ Minor bug fixes to further improve overall stability.
 ⚙️ Small optimizations were made to enhance performance and reduce minor hitches.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/f45fff37cc9202718f6e9894fab6e6d577426ed8.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/868789f6621903a1d3abf8e35108389cacf94495.gif

💖 Thank you so much for always standing by our side! 💖
It’s a true joy to walk this journey together with all of you! 🚜✨

notes.title: Update- Cashier System & Improvements – v0.2.0
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! ❤️

The 0.2.0 update is here, bringing brand new features and improvements to the world of Fuel Harvest Together. Here's what's new:

🧑‍💼 Cashier System Added


 You can now hire a cashier in both singleplayer and multiplayer modes for a daily salary.
 The first payment is made when you hire them, and after that, their salary is automatically deducted every day at 6:00 PM.
 If you can’t pay their salary, the cashier will leave the job. 😢
 While a cashier is active, you can't manually scan products, but you can control their shifts from the tablet. 📱


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/0e1ded0dcd3435a9015075d4e7bf266d6c406e28.jpg

📋 New Employees Menu


 A new "Employees" menu has been added to the tablet.
 In future updates, all new hireable workers will be managed here, along with their shift status.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/beaffa836c9811da41676d0721dee1957b64f445.jpg

⛽ Fuel Transfer and Silo Improvements


 Fuel transfer speed through hoses has been increased 4x! 🚀
 Hoses will now stay connected to their point unless you manually detach them.
 The processing speed of large silos has been increased 4x.
 Large conversion silos now have a crude oil and target fuel capacity of 250 liters. 🛢️


🛢️ Barrel Delivery Improvements


 When delivering fuel to gas stations using barrels, the UI will no longer make you wait.
 It will now simply act as an indicator while you continue working smoothly.


🔧 General Improvements

 Various minor bug fixes. 🐛
 Some small optimizations were made. ⚙️


Thank you so much for all your feedback and support! ❤️

notes.title: Update & Patch Notes – Version 0.1.8
notes.notes:
Hey everyone ❤️

Our new update is live! With this version, we’ve implemented many suggestions from the community. As we continue our Early Access journey, we're shaping Fuel Harvest Together based on your feedback.

Here's what's new in v0.1.8:

🛢️ Fuel Station Orders Now Scale with Level

 Fuel stations now place larger orders as your level increases. The higher your level, the more fuel they will request.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/a21fc5449e424ae25ea19572f89e865de6a7c834.png

🚚 Pickup Truck Capacity and Price Updates

All pickup trucks have received updated capacities and prices:


 Grey Pickup: 9 barrel capacity (Free)
 Red Pickup: 18 barrel capacity ($2000)
 Black Pickup: 18 barrel capacity ($4000)
 Blue Pickup: 27 barrel capacity ($5000)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/6a37713d2c561e4a135a9b6670eab5faf5a11af0.png

🗺️ View Order Details on the Map

 You can now see how much of each fuel type has been ordered and delivered directly on the map for each station.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/46df22c4323852167d71977645fe0a21146da851.png

🔧 General Improvements and Bug Fixes


 Fixed a visual bug where pickup trucks appeared damaged after loading a saved game
 You can now place products on shelves even if a customer is approaching them
 Fixed an issue where some shelves wouldn’t accept products despite having space
 Resolved a bug where shelves skipped the middle slot and only filled the sides
 Various small bug fixes and optimizations
 Adjusted the in-game economy to better reflect the new order and delivery system


🔜 Coming Soon
We’re currently working on the next big features:


 Cashier system
 Wholesale contract mechanics for expanded business opportunities


These features are actively in development and will be coming soon!

Note:
In version "0.1.8", the middle number "1" represents the major update, while the last number "8" reflects the number of patches within that update. This helps us keep updates clear and easy to track.

Thanks again for your continued support! ❤️

notes.title: Major Bug Fixes and What's Next?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been exactly 3 days since we launched our Early Access journey.
First of all, we would like to sincerely thank all players who shared their feedback and bug reports with us through Discord, QQ, and Steam Discussions during this important period.

Even though we conducted extensive testing before launch, thanks to your support, we were able to quickly detect and fix issues that emerged with real player traffic.
We sincerely apologize to players who experienced data loss or serious problems. Your patience and understanding mean a lot to us. ❤️

Here's a summary of what we've fixed over these past 3 days through important patches:

🛠️ Patch Notes Summary:

Version 0.0.2   Fixed customer movement issues.  Added the [Optimize Liquid Physics] option to address FPS drops and crash issues during oil extraction.  Fixed an issue where pumpjacks could not be destroyed.  Added an exit button to the Store Customization screen.  Small performance improvements were made.  Various minor bug fixes.  Minor UI adjustments. 

Version 0.0.3   Fixed the data loss issue that caused players to revert to Level 1 and $100.  Fixed the black screen issue when launching the game in Offline Mode.  Fixed the issue where products would disappear in the store.  Reduced sun brightness.  UI improvements.  Minor bug fixes. 

Version 0.0.4   Added an "Unstuck" (Flip Vehicle) option to the pause menu for trucks and tankers.  Fixed an issue where saved games could not be loaded in Single Player mode.  Increased trailer capacity to 3000.  Disabled collision issues on cactuses.  Various minor bug fixes. 

Version 0.0.5   Fixed an issue where "ESC" and "TAB" keys would not work after establishing a hose connection.  Fixed an issue where hoses could not be picked up again after placement in Single Player mode. 

Version 0.0.6   Fixed barrel and machine issues in Multiplayer mode.  Fixed save data loss caused by these Multiplayer issues.  Fixed an error when deleting pumpjacks.  Fixed an error when throwing crates into the trash. 

📢 What's Next?   Adding an item selling system.  Increasing gas station orders based on player level.  Adding silos for storing large quantities of oil.  Creating wholesale contract systems and bulk sales mechanics.  Improving worker systems, especially for Single Player mode (with additional improvements for Multiplayer as well).  Developing an advanced sound system (enhancing environment and interaction sounds).  Expanding the store garage area.  Developing an improved customer system. 

And of course, we will continue working on many new mechanics based on your feedback and suggestions!

We are shaping Fuel Harvest Together together.
Thank you once again to all players who have supported us with their constructive feedback. ❤️

notes.title: Devlog: Demo Release Date & New Features! 🔥
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 👋

Big news today:

Fuel Harvest Together's demo is launching on March 21st! 🎉 As we get closer to release, I'm continuing to improve the game.

🔥 New Mechanic: Pumpjacks Catch Fire When They Wear Out!
That show we all know (yes, that one 😏) inspired me, and now, when pumpjacks reach the end of their lifespan, they catch fire! ⛽🔥 Old machines will eventually explode, turning into scrap that you can sell to invest in new equipment. It’s not just visually awesome—it also adds to the dynamic nature of the fuel business!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45459286/6550ecd6d81efacb6c876af558239a147dfbae2a.gif

💡 Smoother, More Polished Gameplay
The demo will offer a gameplay experience very close to the full release. I’ve been improving physics, animations, UI, and resource management to make everything smoother and more satisfying.

🌍 Multiplayer is ON!
And the best part? Multiplayer will be fully available in the demo! You’ll be able to gather fuel, manage equipment, and compete to become the ultimate oil tycoon—team up or go solo, the choice is yours!

📢 Thank You for Your Support!
A huge THANK YOU to everyone who has supported, shared feedback, and followed the game’s progress! 💙 Your input is incredibly valuable, and I’ll keep listening to the community to make Fuel Harvest Together the best it can be.

📅 Mark your calendars for March 21st! 🚀 Remember, machines don’t last forever… When your pumpjacks reach their limit, get ready to say goodbye! 🔥

See you soon! 🚜⛽
